work.sae_explanation: An SAÉ (Situation d'Apprentissage et d'Évaluation) is a project-based learning module required in the French higher education system to build practical engineering competencies.

mnia-env.title: MNIA Project (Numerical Methods Applied to AI)
mnia-env.presentationDescription: Developing a custom environment for a Reinforcement Learning (RL) agent.
mnia-env.section_text: Building a basic RL model to benchmark the environment.
mnia-env.skill3: Full autonomy in language selection (Java selected); designed code architecture from scratch.

pagil1.title: Terminal Game Development using Agile SCRUM
pagil1.text1: Built a console game within a few days under Agile Scrum. Teams were assigned randomly across the entire cohort, providing valuable experience in collaborating with new team members.
pagil1.text2: Served as Scrum Master, managing User Stories, maintaining the task board, and producing Burn-Up and Burn-Down charts to track sprint progress.

pagil2.title: Full-Stack Web Application (CodeSwipe)
pagil2.presentationDescription: Developed a full-stack Web application in a fast-paced Agile sprint. CodeSwipe is a satirical Tinder clone where users swipe on code snippets instead of profiles.
pagil2.roleDescription: Rotated into the Scrum Master role, overseeing project progress, burn-up tracking, Git branch discipline, and ticket workflows.

sae103.title: Network Services & Workstation Setup
sae103.presentationDescription: SAÉ 1.03 introduced foundational networking concepts, while SAÉ 2.03 focused on corporate network configuration and technical documentation using Markdown and AsciiDoc.
sae103.machine_install_text: Configured virtual machines manually and via automated scripts, enhancing problem-solving and documentation analysis skills.

sae105.title: Corporate Website Design & Development
sae105.presentationDescription: Analyzed corporate requirements for an employee carpooling platform. Designed initial mockups and translated them into a functional website.
sae105.wordpress_text: Created WordPress prototypes to refine layout ideas before coding the production version in vanilla HTML/CSS while adhering strictly to design guidelines.

sae202.title: Student Exchange Application (Java / JavaFX)
sae202.presentationDescription: Built an application to manage international student exchanges, matching candidates based on affinity metrics computed via graph algorithms (Dijkstra).
sae202.interface_description: Migrated an initial CLI prototype into a modern JavaFX graphical user interface to enhance usability.

sae207.title: Database Design & Data Normalization
sae207.presentationDescription: Extracted, structured, and normalized raw data from large files into relational database schemas.
sae207.postgresql_text: Built tables and wrote complex SQL queries in PostgreSQL and MS Access to extract business insights.

sae213.title: Interactive Escape Game Project
sae213.presentationDescription: Focused on team collaboration using tools like Genially and Trello to coordinate puzzle creation and project tracking.
sae213.text1: Organized regular team meetings, drafted meeting minutes, and tracked individual task progression to ensure aligned goals.
sae213.text2: Configured a self-hosted Gitea instance for source control and documented overall engineering processes using Markdown.

sae302.title: MonsterHunt Game (JavaFX)
sae302.presentationDescription: Designed a two-player turn-based game (Monster vs. Hunter) from baseline gameplay rules and UI wireframes.
sae302.testingDescription: Emphasized unit testing coverage, architectural design patterns, and clear code documentation.

sae401.title: RESTful API Development
sae401.presentationDescription: Designed and implemented a backend REST API for a pizzeria application ('Pizzeria Mazzorello').
sae401.security_description: Integrated authentication mechanisms including API Tokens and JSON Web Tokens (JWT).
sae401.skill1_text: Gained strong hands-on experience designing RESTful webservices.
sae401.skill2_text: Designed and connected a relational PostgreSQL database.
sae401.know_how1_text: Executed the full project individually, demonstrating strong self-management.
sae401.know_how2_text: Delivered a fully compliant application within tight timeline constraints.

sae402.title: Complex Real-Time Multiplayer Application
sae402.presentationDescription: Engineered a custom multiplayer application meeting core functional requirements specified in a detailed project brief.
sae402.multiplayer_description: Implemented client-server synchronization using Socket.io, supporting multiple concurrent game instances using room-based routing.
sae402.skill1_text: Deepened JS skills through building complex front/back client logic.
sae402.skill2_text: Built scalable websocket events for real-time game state synchronization.
sae402.skill3_text: Managed build chains and package dependencies via npm/package.json.
sae402.skill4_text: Rendered 2D graphics and sprites dynamically on canvas elements.
sae402.know_how1_text: Completed the project in a pair instead of a group of three, meeting deadlines without scope reduction.
sae402.know_how2_text: Maintained structured task allocation to deliver both core and stretch features.
sae402.know_how3_text: Practiced clean commit conventions, milestone tracking, and issue management in GitLab.

sae501.title: RISC-V Hardware Emulator in C
sae501.presentationDescription: Developed a low-level computer emulator modeling a RISC-V processor architecture.
sae501.programmingDescription: Simulated hardware registers, ALU operations, and memory instruction execution cycles through structured low-level C programming.

sae509.title: Backend Web Development (Spring)
sae509.presentationDescription: Built a multi-user appointment management platform using Java backend frameworks.
sae509.spring_description: Used Spring Boot and Spring Security to build a secure enterprise application featuring Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) for User and Admin roles.
